# Reference catalog

See [the numerical-reference guide](../../../docs/reference-fixtures.md) for source
attribution, derivations, tolerances, and update policy.

`manifest.json` pins the four test datasets and the checksums of their input,
expected, and invalid-case artifacts. These original JSON fixtures use the
repository MIT license; cited third-party source material retains its own terms.

All entries are test fixtures. The R-generated baseline is labeled reference-only
until corresponding Python methods exist; there are no teaching datasets. Normal regression tests load these local files without a network
connection or R installation.
